# Native test fixtures

The native test harness uses deterministic synthetic NAL units and a strict
libdovi boundary fake so framing, capacity, state, and fail-closed behavior can
be exercised without redistributing media.

Real integration fixtures may be placed here later as paired input and expected
RPU binaries generated by the same resolved upstream revision. Do not commit
copyrighted video samples or generated upstream source trees.

Deferred fake-boundary suite: `native/tests/run-tests.sh`

Deferred real-library matrix:
`native/tests/run-tests.sh LIBDOVI_STATIC P7_INPUT EXPECTED_P81 P84_INPUT EXPECTED_P84`

The real-library route verifies scalar inspection, exact P8.1 and P8.4 output,
all four repairs, official AV1 T.35 payload/complete structure, HDR10+ metadata
preservation, and source-base stripping.

Expected later: all `dovi` native tests pass with the resolved upstream
revision.
